description: [40 credits] Per episode started. Reads the show's feed (or the items given), skips items already made, and — within max_episodes_per_run and max_credits_per_day — starts one video per new item. Without confirm: the list, nothing spent. On a held show, confirm=true is the owner's one-time approval: it makes the episodes and lets the scheduler run the show from then on.

confirm.description: false (the default): a free preview of the episodes this run would make. true: make them, and on a held show, confirm it — from then on the scheduler runs it at its cadence.

items.description: The items to make episodes from, for a manual show. A feed show ignores this and reads its feed.

key.description: Stable id of the item; the same key is never made twice. Defaults to the link.

link.description: The item's page, http(s). Required for a video show — it is the page that gets filmed.

show_id.description: The show_id from create_show or list_shows.

name: run_show
title: Run a show now
